rv.q: With beauty, elegance and a versatile, big stage voice, Umoh is razzmatazz in leading lady form.

cn.t: This bare-bones revival of the 1968 musical offers a strong Styne-Comden-Green score tackling racism, but critics remain divided on whether the dated book works, even as the old-school Broadway style shines through.
